categories.name: Aktionariat Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens representing fractionalized private corporate equity issued and managed via Aktionariat (https://portal.aktionariat.com/).

categories.name: Rebase Tokens
categories.content: Rebase tokens are cryptocurrencies that are usually pegged to a certain value, and they control their prices by algorithmically adjusting their token’s circulating supply.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Pools.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pools.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pools.fun

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Moonshot Ecosystem
categories.content: Moonshot Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via https://moonshot.money/.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Dominion Market Ecosystem
categories.content: Dominion Market is a real-world asset platform focused on bringing physical commodities on-chain.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: DeFAI
categories.content: DeFAI or AIFI projects leverage AI to streamline and automate DeFi activities such as trading, staking, yield farming, market analysis, and investment optimization.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: Stonk Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on StonkFun.fun (https://www.stonkfun.xyz/).

categories.name: Privacy Blockchain
categories.content: Programmable Layer 1 or Layer 2 networks that serve as platforms for dApps while prioritizing confidentiality. Unlike standard, general-purpose programmable blockchains like Ethereum, these networks have privacy preserved at the consensus or execution layer, enabling "private-by-default" or "opt-in private" smart contracts.

categories.name: Bitcoin Sidechains
categories.content: Bitcoin Sidechains are designed to enhance the Bitcoin blockchain's capacity by creating a new layer that improves transaction processing speed by handling transactions off the primary chain.

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: Coinbase Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized U.S. equities issued by Coinbase and deployed on Base under its B20 tokenized equity standard, launched in 2026 for non-U.S. customers. Tokens are identified by a "C" suffix appended to the underlying ticker and can be traded onchain on DEXs.
